name: Clark Construction Group, LLC
summary: General contractor, construction manager, and design-builder; one of the largest commercial and civil contractors in the U.S.
note: The GC's sub 'Clark Construction Group' in Bethesda, MD, matches the federal contractor CLARK CONSTRUCTION GROUP LLC (Bethesda, MD, UEI QQBXQR679KM9) and the firm publishing as Clark Construction (clarkconstruction.com), whose Bethesda office at 7500 Old Georgetown Road matches the OSHA-matched address 7500 OLD GEORGETOWN RD, BETHESDA, MD, 20814. Note Wikipedia gives McLean, Virginia, as the headquarters and lists www.clarkgroup.com, and it also lists many subsidiaries (e.g., Shirley Contracting, Clark Civil, C3M Power Systems) that are separate companies and are not included here as Clark's own locations.
